simple.meaning: חַלָּמִישׁ (challâmîysh) is a Hebrew object word meaning “flint.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Deuteronomy 8:15. The surrounding context includes wilderness.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to חַלָּמִישׁ (H2496) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.
simple.summary: חַלָּמִישׁ (challâmîysh) / H2496 is traced through Deuteronomy 8:15, Deuteronomy 32:13, Job 28:9, Psalms 114:8 with generated occurrence evidence.

definitions.full: H2496. challamish חַלָּמִישׁ noun masculine flint ; — חַלָּמִישׁ Deut 8:15 3 t.; construct חַלְמִישׁ 32:13 ; — flint הַח ׳צוּר rock of flint = flinty rock, whence water flowed for Israel in desert 8:15 , and (no צור ) Psa 114:8 ; worked by miners Job 28:9 ; hyperb. oil out of ׳ח צוּר Deut 32:13 flint of rock = rocky flint (poetry); — in simile of firmness כַּחַלָּמִישׁ מָּנַי שַׂמְתִּי עַלכֵּֿן Isa 50:7 . חֹלוֺן חֵלֹן, see below I. and II. חוֺל .
definitions.rootNote: probably from 2492 (in the sense of hardness );

occurrences.englishText: who led you through the great and terrible wilderness, with venomous snakes and scorpions, and thirsty ground where there was no water; who poured water for you out of the rock of flint;
He made him ride on the high places of the earth.
He puts his hand on the flinty rock,
who turned the rock into a pool of water,
For the Lord Yahweh will help me.
